clips.name: brightness-amount
clips.alt: The dancer on a dark stage with Brightness while Amount runs from −0.8 to 0.8 and back: the stage sinks into night until only her dress and the spotlights remain, then lifts until the haze and curtains show, while the deepest shadows stay dark and the brightest light never burns out; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Amount from −0.8 to 0.8 and back.

clips.name: contrast-amount
clips.alt: The dancer turning on a dark stage with Contrast while Amount runs from 0.4 to 1.8 and back: at first the whole stage is a pale, misty grey, then the haze sinks into black while the dress and skin glow brighter and warmer, and back to the grey veil; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Amount from 0.4 to 1.8 and back.

clips.name: exposure-exposure
clips.alt: The dancer turning on a dark stage with Exposure while it runs from −2 to +2 EV and back: first she is a dim figure in the dark, then the light comes up evenly over the whole stage until the haze glows and the brightest folds of her dress burn out to white; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Exposure from −2 to +2 EV and back.

clips.name: levels-gamma
clips.alt: The dancer turning on a dark stage with Levels while Gamma runs from 0.5 to 2 and back: first the haze and her skin are heavy and dark, then the mid-tones open into a light, soft grey, while pure black and the white of the dress stay where they are; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Gamma from 0.5 to 2 and back.

clips.name: saturation-amount
clips.alt: The dancer turning on a dark stage with Saturation while Amount runs from 0 to 1.8 and back: first the whole picture is black and white, then the warm stage light, her skin and the blue backlight come back and grow strong and glowing, while the brightness of every part stays the same; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Amount from 0 to 1.8 and back.

clips.name: vibrance-amount
clips.alt: The harbour town while Vibrance runs from −1 to 2 and back: at −1 the pale sky and the pastel house fronts turn almost grey while the turquoise sea keeps much of its colour, then the sky deepens to a strong blue and the pink and yellow walls fill with colour, while the sea and the white boats change little; the current value is shown at the bottom left
clips.caption: Amount from −1 to 2 and back.
